name: observability-and-evaluation
description: Record dialogue trajectories and open a persistent local evaluation UI on request.

display_description.en: Keep a combined trajectory for each dialogue and open its evaluation UI on request; analysis starts only with Run Evaluation.
display_description.zh: 按对话保存并合并执行轨迹，按需打开持久化本地评估界面，选择模型与参数后手动启动分析。

quick_inputs.en: Collect execution traces for later failure analysis.
quick_inputs.zh: 请记录执行轨迹以便后续故障分析。

quick_inputs.en: Let me upload a trajectory and configure its evaluation.
quick_inputs.zh: 让我上传轨迹并配置评估参数。

display_description.en: Attach the existing observer to the inner agent, force non-streaming model calls, and save traces in the session workspace.
display_description.zh: 为内部智能体接入现有观测模块，强制模型使用非流式调用，并在工作区按会话保存轨迹。

display_description.en: Track all recorded turns in one dialogue trajectory and preserve its UI metadata. Evaluation is manual.
display_description.zh: 将对话的全部已记录轮次合并为轨迹并保存界面元数据，评估由用户手动启动。

display_description.en: Return the current dialogue evaluation link without starting analysis.
display_description.zh: 返回当前对话的评估链接，由用户手动启动分析。
